text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I kept wondering, "Why only me?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Sadness, frustration,
envy. ...And then, well—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Maybe she was just lonely.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I wished we were the same.
If only we were just a little bit more alike."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If only I were a little more like them...
Like Big sis, and like Vivlos—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I wish I could have... stood at the same level as them, in the same place, and smiled together like that.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...But—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah—!
I'm not gonna lose...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaahhhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, I won't give it up...!
Hyaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Vivlos, what incredible spring...! And her sister's closing stride is phenomenal too——)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Ngh, but I can too! Even I can!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahã¼ã¼ã¼!!

text_block_list.name: Three Sisters
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, gasp*...!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, ngh...
Heh, heheheh—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahahahahah!!
Aaaah~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That was soooo much fun,
Cheval-chi, Big Sis!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Hey, come on...
Right after a serious match, too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I can't really deny that, though.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Phew... So, how was that? Did it fire you up, Cheval?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup.
Has your resolve to win grown even stronger?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... Thank you, Sis... and Vivlos.
And so, after putting on a spectacular race, all three sisters returned together to the underground tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey, hey, Trainer!!
You have your smartphone, right?
Take a picture, take one! Right now!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Me, Cheval-chi, and big sis!
All three of us together—take a picture, pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait a second! Right after the race,
when everything's such a mess...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"A-Are you sure...
we should really take it now?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No, no, right now is perfect~!
Come on, Big Sis, Cheval-chi,
squeeze in, squeeze in! Smiiiile~~~!
(Splash!!)
The smiling photo of the three sisters taken that day—well, it was hard to say they looked very similar, but still.

"And that is why each and every one of them is beautiful.
That was what came to mind."
